mission: Prepare members for careers in healthcare through rigorous scholarship, structured mentorship, clinical exposure, and sustained community service.
history: Mu Epsilon Delta was founded in 1965 at the University of Tennessee at Martin as a co-educational professional fraternity for students pursuing pre-health careers. The organization exists to connect students across healthcare pathways, raise the standard of pre-professional preparation, and sustain a network of mentors from campus through clinical practice.
foundingStory: What began as a single chapter focused on health-science scholarship has grown into a national network of chapters. Colors are maroon and gold; the symbol is the caduceus; the flower is the red rambling rose; the jewel is the ruby. The fraternity motto is: “With purity and passion I pass my life and practice my art.”

values.title: Scholarship
values.body: Academic standards, peer study structure, and application-ready advising for medical and health-professional schools.

values.title: Service
values.body: Sustained partnerships with local clinics, blood drives, and health-education initiatives—not one-off photo ops.

values.title: Mentorship
values.body: Upperclass and alumni mentors matched to members by pathway (MD, DO, PA, dental, pharmacy, nursing, research).

values.title: Professional Development
values.body: Speaker series, suturing and clinical skills workshops, interview practice, and AMCAS/AACOMAS application clinics.
